global_store_short_d16_hi.d: Store 16 bits of data from the high 16 bits of a 32-bit vector register into the global aperture.

global_wb.d: Write back dirty cache lines based on the SCOPE field. Increments/decrements STORE_CNT.

global_wbinv.d: Write back and invalidate cache lines based on the SCOPE field. Increments/decrements STORE_CNT.

image_atomic_add.d: Add two unsigned 32-bit integer values stored in the data register and a location in an image surface. Store the original value from image surface into a vector register iff the GLC bit is set.

image_atomic_add_flt.d: Add two single-precision float values stored in the data register and a location in an image surface. Store the original value from image surface into a vector register iff the temporal hint enables atomic return.

image_atomic_add_uint.d: Add two unsigned 32-bit integer values stored in the data register and a location in an image surface. Store the original value from image surface into a vector register iff the temporal hint enables atomic return.

image_atomic_and.d: Calculate bitwise AND given two unsigned 32-bit integer values stored in the data register and a location in an image surface. Store the original value from image surface into a vector register iff the temporal hint enables atomic return.

image_atomic_cmpswap.d: Compare two unsigned 32-bit integer values stored in the data comparison register and a location in an image surface. Modify the memory location with a value in the data source register iff the comparison is equal. Store the original value from image surface into a vector register iff the temporal hint enables atomic return.

image_atomic_dec.d: Decrement an unsigned 32-bit integer value from a location in an image surface with wraparound to a value in the data register if the decrement yields a negative value. Store the original value from image surface into a vector register iff the GLC bit is set.

image_atomic_dec_uint.d: Decrement an unsigned 32-bit integer value from a location in an image surface with wraparound to a value in the data register if the decrement yields a negative value. Store the original value from image surface into a vector register iff the temporal hint enables atomic return.

image_atomic_fcmpswap.d: Compare two single-precision float values stored in the data comparison register and a location in an image surface. Modify the memory location with a value in the data source register iff the comparison is equal. Store the original value from image surface into a vector register iff the GLC bit is set.

image_atomic_fmax.d: Select the maximum of two single-precision float inputs, given two values stored in the data register and a location in an image surface. Update the image surface with the selected value. Store the original value from image surface into a vector register iff the GLC bit is set.

image_atomic_fmin.d: Select the minimum of two single-precision float inputs, given two values stored in the data register and a location in an image surface. Update the image surface with the selected value. Store the original value from image surface into a vector register iff the GLC bit is set.

image_atomic_inc.d: Increment an unsigned 32-bit integer value from a location in an image surface with wraparound to 0 if the value exceeds a value in the data register. Store the original value from image surface into a vector register iff the GLC bit is set.

image_atomic_inc_uint.d: Increment an unsigned 32-bit integer value from a location in an image surface with wraparound to 0 if the value exceeds a value in the data register. Store the original value from image surface into a vector register iff the temporal hint enables atomic return.

image_atomic_max_flt.d: Select the IEEE maximumNumber() of two single-precision float inputs, given two values stored in the data register and a location in an image surface. Update the image surface with the selected value. Store the original value from image surface into a vector register iff the temporal hint enables atomic return.

image_atomic_max_int.d: Select the maximum of two signed 32-bit integer inputs, given two values stored in the data register and a location in an image surface. Update the image surface with the selected value. Store the original value from image surface into a vector register iff the temporal hint enables atomic return.

image_atomic_max_uint.d: Select the maximum of two unsigned 32-bit integer inputs, given two values stored in the data register and a location in an image surface. Update the image surface with the selected value. Store the original value from image surface into a vector register iff the temporal hint enables atomic return.

image_atomic_min_flt.d: Select the IEEE minimumNumber() of two single-precision float inputs, given two values stored in the data register and a location in an image surface. Update the image surface with the selected value. Store the original value from image surface into a vector register iff the temporal hint enables atomic return.

image_atomic_min_int.d: Select the minimum of two signed 32-bit integer inputs, given two values stored in the data register and a location in an image surface. image_atomic_min_uint.d: Select the minimum of two unsigned 32-bit integer inputs, given two values stored in the data register and a location in an image surface. Update the image surface with the selected value. Store the original value from image surface into a vector register iff the temporal hint enables atomic return.

image_atomic_or.d: Calculate bitwise OR given two unsigned 32-bit integer values stored in the data register and a location in an image surface. Store the original value from image surface into a vector register iff the temporal hint enables atomic return.

image_atomic_pk_add_bf16.d: Add a packed 2-component BF16 float value from the data register to a location in an image surface. Store the original value from image surface into a vector register iff the temporal hint enables atomic return.

image_atomic_pk_add_f16.d: Add a packed 2-component half-precision float value from the data register to a location in an image surface. Store the original value from image surface into a vector register iff the temporal hint enables atomic return.

image_atomic_smax.d: Select the maximum of two signed 32-bit integer inputs, given two values stored in the data register and a location in an image surface. Update the image surface with the selected value. Store the original value from image surface into a vector register iff the GLC bit is set.

image_atomic_smin.d: Select the minimum of two signed 32-bit integer inputs, given two values stored in the data register and a location in an image surface. Update the image surface with the selected value. Store the original value from image surface into a vector register iff the GLC bit is set.

image_atomic_sub.d: Subtract an unsigned 32-bit integer value stored in the data register from a value stored in a location in an image surface. Store the original value from image surface into a vector register iff the GLC bit is set.

image_atomic_sub_uint.d: Subtract an unsigned 32-bit integer value stored in the data register from a value stored in a location in an image surface. Store the original value from image surface into a vector register iff the temporal hint enables atomic return.

image_atomic_swap.d: Swap an unsigned 32-bit integer value in the data register with a location in an image surface. Store the original value from image surface into a vector register iff the temporal hint enables atomic return.

image_atomic_umax.d: Select the maximum of two unsigned 32-bit integer inputs, given two values stored in the data register and a location in an image surface. Update the image surface with the selected value. Store the original value from image surface into a vector register iff the GLC bit is set.

image_atomic_umin.d: Select the minimum of two unsigned 32-bit integer inputs, given two values stored in the data register and a location in an image surface. image_atomic_xor.d: Calculate bitwise XOR given two unsigned 32-bit integer values stored in the data register and a location in an image surface. Store the original value from image surface into a vector register iff the temporal hint enables atomic return.

image_bvh64_intersect_ray.d: Test the intersection of rays with either box nodes or triangle nodes within a bounded volume hierarchy using 64 bit node pointers. Store the results of the test into a vector register. This instruction does not take a sampler constant.

image_bvh8_intersect_ray.d: This instruction supports testing one BVH8 node against one ray per lane using both intersection engines.

image_bvh_dual_intersect_ray.d: This instruction supports testing two QBVH nodes against the same ray per lane using both intersection engines. It is typically used to implement the BVH4x2 traversal algorithm.

image_bvh_intersect_ray.d: Test the intersection of rays with either box nodes or triangle nodes within a bounded volume hierarchy using 32 bit node pointers. Store the results of the test into a vector register. This instruction does not take a sampler constant.

image_get_lod.d: Return the calculated level of detail (LOD) for the provided input as two single-precision float values. No memory access is performed.

image_get_resinfo.d: Gather resource information for a given miplevel provided in the address register. Returns 4 integer values into registers 3:0 as { num_mip_levels, depth, height, width }. No memory access is performed.

image_load.d: Load a texel from the largest miplevel in an image surface and store the result into a vector register. Perform the format conversion specified by the resource descriptor. No sampling is performed.

image_load_by2.d: Load 2 horizontal elements from the largest miplevel in an image surface and store the result into a vector register. Perform the format conversion specified by the resource descriptor. Illegal for formats with more than 2 components. No sampling is performed.

image_load_by4.d: Load 4 horizontal elements from the largest miplevel in an image surface and store the result into a vector register. Perform the format conversion specified by the resource descriptor. Illegal for formats with more than 1 component. No sampling is performed.

image_load_mip.d: Load a texel from a user-specified miplevel in an image surface and store the result into a vector register. Perform the format conversion specified by the resource descriptor. No sampling is performed.

image_load_mip_by2.d: Load 2 horizontal elements from a user-specified miplevel in an image surface and store the result into a vector register. Perform the format conversion specified by the resource descriptor. Illegal for formats with more than 2 components. No sampling is performed.

image_load_mip_by4.d: Load 4 horizontal elements from a user-specified miplevel in an image surface and store the result into a vector register. Perform the format conversion specified by the resource descriptor. Illegal for formats with more than 1 component. No sampling is performed.

image_load_mip_pck.d: Load a texel from a user-specified miplevel in an image surface and store the result into a vector register. 8- and 16-bit components are zero-extended. The format specified in the resource descriptor is ignored. No sampling is performed.

image_load_mip_pck2.d: Load 2 horizontal elements from a user-specified miplevel in an image surface and store the result into a vector register. 8- and 16-bit components are zero-extended. The format specified in the resource descriptor is ignored. Illegal for element sizes greater than 64 bits. No sampling is performed.

image_load_mip_pck4.d: Load 4 horizontal elements from a user-specified miplevel in an image surface and store the result into a vector register. 8- and 16-bit components are zero-extended. The format specified in the resource descriptor is ignored. Illegal for element sizes greater than 32 bits. No sampling is performed.

image_load_mip_pck_sgn.d: Load a texel from a user-specified miplevel in an image surface and store the result into a vector register. 8- and 16-bit components are sign-extended. The format specified in the resource descriptor is ignored. No sampling is performed.

image_msaa_load.d: Load up to 4 samples of 1 component from an MSAA resource with a user-specified fragment ID. No sampling is performed.

s_set_vgpr_msb.d: Set the MSBs of the logical VGPR address for subsequent vector instructions that use VGPRs. The operand is an immediate value that sets the MSBs as follows:

s_sethalt.d: Set or clear the HALT or FATAL_HALT status bits.

s_setkill.d: Kill this wave if the least significant bit of the immediate constant is 1.

s_setpc_b64.d: Jump to an address specified in a scalar register.

s_setprio_inc_wg.d: Increment the user priority of every wave in this workgroup by the amount specified in SIMM16[1:0], wrap around on overflow. USER_PRIO is 2 bits with 0 representing the lowest priority and 3 representing the highest. See S_SETPRIO for details.

s_setreg_b32.d: Write some or all of the LSBs of source argument into a hardware register.

s_setreg_imm32_b32.d: Write some or all of the LSBs of a 32-bit literal constant into a hardware register; this instruction requires a 32-bit literal constant.

s_sext_i32_i8.d: Sign extend a signed 8 bit scalar input to 32 bits and store the result into a scalar register.

s_sleep.d: Cause a wave to sleep for up to ~8000 clocks, or to sleep until an external event wakes the wave up.

s_sleep_var.d: Cause a wave to sleep for up to ~8000 clocks, or to sleep until an external event wakes the wave up.

s_store_dword.d: Store 32 bits of data from a scalar register into the scalar memory.

s_store_dwordx2.d: Store 64 bits of data from a scalar register into the scalar memory.

s_store_dwordx4.d: Store 128 bits of data from a scalar register into the scalar memory.

s_sub_co_ci_u32.d: Subtract the second unsigned 32-bit integer input from the first input, subtract the carry-in bit, store the result into a scalar register and store the carry-out bit into SCC.

s_sub_co_i32.d: Subtract the second signed 32-bit integer input from the first input, store the result into a scalar register and store the carry-out bit into SCC.

s_sub_co_u32.d: Subtract the second unsigned 32-bit integer input from the first input, store the result into a scalar register and store the carry-out bit into SCC.

s_sub_f32.d: Subtract the second floating point input from the first input and store the result in a scalar register.

s_sub_i32.d: Subtract the second signed 32-bit integer input from the first input, store the result into a scalar register and store the carry-out bit into SCC.

s_sub_nc_u64.d: Subtract the second unsigned 64-bit integer input from the first input and store the result into a scalar register.

s_sub_u32.d: Subtract the second unsigned 32-bit integer input from the first input, store the result into a scalar register and store the carry-out bit into SCC.

s_subb_u32.d: Subtract the second unsigned 32-bit integer input from the first input, subtract the carry-in bit, store the result into a scalar register and store the carry-out bit into SCC.

s_subvector_loop_end.d: End execution of a subvector block of code.

s_swap_pc_i64.d: Store the address of the next instruction to a scalar register and then jump to an address specified in the scalar input.

s_swappc_b64.d: Store the address of the next instruction to a scalar register and then jump to an address specified in the scalar input.

s_trunc_f16.d: Compute the integer part of a half-precision float input using round toward zero semantics and store the result in floating point format into a scalar register.

s_trunc_f32.d: Compute the integer part of a single-precision float input using round toward zero semantics and store the result in floating point format into a scalar register.

s_ttracedata.d: Send M0 as user data to the thread trace stream.

s_ttracedata_imm.d: Send SIMM16[7:0] as user data to the thread trace stream.

s_version.d: Perform no operation. This opcode is used to specify the microcode version for tools that interpret shader microcode.

s_wait_alu.d: Wait for one or more ALU-centric counters to fall below specified values.

s_wait_asynccnt.d: Wait until ASYNCCNT is less than or equal to SIMM16[5:0].

s_wait_bvhcnt.d: Wait until BVHCNT is less than or equal to SIMM16[2:0].

s_wait_dscnt.d: Wait until DSCNT is less than or equal to SIMM16[5:0].

s_wait_event.d: Wait for an event to occur or a condition to be satisfied before continuing. The SIMM16 argument specifies which event(s) to wait on.

s_wait_expcnt.d: Wait until EXPCNT is less than or equal to SIMM16[2:0].

s_wait_idle.d: Wait for all activity in the wave to be complete (all dependency and memory counters at zero).

s_wait_kmcnt.d: Wait until KMCNT is less than or equal to SIMM16[4:0].

s_wait_loadcnt.d: Wait until LOADCNT is less than or equal to SIMM16[5:0].

s_wait_loadcnt_dscnt.d: Wait until LOADCNT is less than or equal to SIMM16[13:8] and DSCNT is less than or equal to SIMM16[5:0].

s_wait_samplecnt.d: Wait until SAMPLECNT is less than or equal to SIMM16[5:0].

s_wait_storecnt.d: Wait until STORECNT is less than or equal to SIMM16[5:0].

s_wait_storecnt_dscnt.d: Wait until STORECNT is less than or equal to SIMM16[13:8] and DSCNT is less than or equal to SIMM16[5:0].

s_wait_tensorcnt.d: Wait until TENSORCNT is less than or equal to SIMM16[5:0].

s_wait_xcnt.d: Wait until XCNT is less than or equal to SIMM16[5:0].

s_waitcnt.d: Wait for the counts of outstanding local data share, vector memory and export instructions to be at or below the specified levels.

s_waitcnt_depctr.d: Wait for one or more ALU-centric counters to fall below specified values. Used in expert scheduling mode.

s_waitcnt_expcnt.d: Wait for the EXPCNT counter to be at or below the specified level. The EXPCNT counter tracks the number of outstanding export events.

s_waitcnt_lgkmcnt.d: Wait for the LGKMCNT counter to be at or below the specified level. The LGKMCNT counter tracks the number of outstanding local data share (L), global data share (G), scalar memory (K) and message (M) events.

s_waitcnt_vmcnt.d: Wait for the VMCNT counter to be at or below the specified level. The VMCNT counter tracks the number of outstanding vector memory loads and atomics that do return data. When in 'all-in-order' mode, wait for all load and store vector memory events.

s_waitcnt_vscnt.d: Wait for the VSCNT counter to be at or below the specified level. The VSCNT counter tracks the number of outstanding vector memory stores and atomics that do not return data. This counter is not used in 'all-in-order' mode.

s_wakeup.d: Allow a wave to 'ping' all the other waves in its threadgroup to force them to wake up early from an S_SLEEP instruction.

s_wakeup_barrier.d: Wake up all waves associated with the named barrier indicated by S0.

s_xnor_saveexec_b64.d: Calculate bitwise XNOR on the scalar input and the EXEC mask, store the calculated result into the EXEC mask, set SCC iff the calculated result is nonzero and store the original value of the EXEC mask into the scalar destination register.

s_xor_b32.d: Calculate bitwise XOR on two scalar inputs, store the result into a scalar register and set SCC iff the result is nonzero.

s_xor_saveexec_b32.d: Calculate bitwise XOR on the scalar input and the EXEC mask, store the calculated result into the EXEC mask, set SCC iff the calculated result is nonzero and store the original value of the EXEC mask into the scalar destination register.

s_xor_saveexec_b64.d: Calculate bitwise XOR on the scalar input and the EXEC mask, store the calculated result into the EXEC mask, set SCC iff the calculated result is nonzero and store the original value of the EXEC mask into the scalar destination register.
